name: io.github.hks409/nanukamachi
title: Nanukamachi Tourism Portal
description: Read-only Nanukamachi-dori tourism data: shops, parking, and digital archives.

tools.name: list-spots
tools.description: Search shops, restaurants, cafes, sights, and accommodation on Nanukamachi-dori. Returns slugs, names, categories, tags, and short summaries.

query.description: Free-text keyword in Japanese or Traditional Chinese.

genre.description: eat/tabe = restaurants and cafes, miru = sights and shops, yado = accommodation.

category.description: Optional data category such as japanesefood, western, ramen, gift, history, building, or antique.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

tools.name: get-spot
tools.description: Get full details for one spot on Nanukamachi-dori by slug or name. Returns the full description by default; use offset and maxChars to page through long articles. descriptionTruncated and nextOffset indicate whether more text remains.

name.description: Spot name, e.g. とんかつ大将.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

offset.description: Start offset for the description. Use nextOffset to continue.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return. Omit to return the full description.

tools.name: list-parking
tools.description: Search parking lots near Nanukamachi-dori. Returns slug, name, fee, available time, category, and short summary.

category.description: car for regular vehicles, bus for bus parking.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

tools.name: get-parking
tools.description: Get full details for one parking lot by slug or name, including fee, hours, surface, coordinates, and canonical URL. Use offset and maxChars to page through long descriptions.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

offset.description: Start offset for the description. Use nextOffset to continue.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return. Omit to return the full description.

tools.name: search-archives
tools.description: Search digitized historical postcards and printed materials from Nanukamachi-dori. Returns slug, name, category, date, and short description.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

tools.name: get-archive
tools.description: Get full details for one digital archive item by slug or name, including full description, category, date, and image URL. Use offset and maxChars to page through long descriptions.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to Japanese. Use en for English.

offset.description: Start offset for the description. Use nextOffset to continue.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return. Omit to return the full description.

tools.name: get-site-info
tools.description: Get an overview of Nanukamachi.com, its languages, main routes, and machine-readable discovery documents.
